subject: QoderWork spawn chips read Agent(agent: ...) instead of the real subagent type
description:
Every QoderWork child spawn renders with the type `agent` — the chip reads "Agent(agent: ...)"
— because QoderWork's spawn tool input names no `subagent_type` and the fold falls back to the
tool name. The source knows better in TWO places, both usually `general-purpose`:
`toolUseResult.agentType` on the RESULT, and `agentType` in the `subagents/` sidecar.

#37 deliberately left the label alone: adopting the sidecar's type for RUNNING spawns only
would have flipped the label back the moment the result folded. So the fix must lift the type
IN-BAND as well, via a QoderWork-local `join_result`.

NEEDS AN OWNER DECISION before starting: this is a rendering change, so it rides a
byte-identical gate re-baseline. Confirm that is wanted for a cosmetic chip label.

Definition of done: QoderWork spawn chips name the real subagent type from both the running
and folded paths, a fixture covering each, and the gate re-baselined line-by-line.

metadata.deferred_reason: needs an owner decision: a cosmetic label fix that forces a byte-gate re-baseline
